findings.evidence: The description does not separate the agent from its own preloaded skill ui-ux-principles, which also triggers on 'review this page' and 'why does this feel off'. Comparing design alternatives and mobile reach are not among its keywords
findings.fix: Use for an honest, research-backed critique of a UI, screen, mockup, screenshot, user flow or design decision, run in its own context. Delegate when asked to review, critique or sanity-check a design, compare design alternatives, or about usability, UX, accessibility, layout, navigation, mobile thumb reach or onboarding, or when the user wants pushback with cited sources, even without the word UX. Not for implementing frontend code or generating new designs from scratch; for a quick in-context rule check while building a component, use the ui-ux-principles skill directly.
